entities.summary: Hsieh Cheng-peng is a tennis player from Taiwan. He reached a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 62 in June 2019. He reached the final at the 2019 Sofia Open with partner Christopher Rungkat. Hsieh Cheng-peng was a athletes & competitors from Taipei (b. 1991-09-22, Taipei). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
